heading: Report on environmental problems in Poland and Hungary
lead: The first report submitted pursuant to section 5474 of this title shall include the following:

tree.heading: Assessment of problems
tree.text: An overall assessment of the environmental problems facing Poland and Hungary, including—

children.text: a relative ranking of the severity of the problems and their effects on both human health and the general environment;
a listing of the geographical areas of each country that have suffered the heaviest environmental damage, and a description of the source and scope of the damage; and
an assessment of the environmental performance of leading industrial polluters in those countries and the expected effect on pollution levels of industrial modernization.

tree.heading: Priorities and costs for action
tree.text: An analysis of the priorities that Poland and Hungary should each assign in addressing its environmental problems, and an estimate of the capital and human resources required to undertake a comprehensive program of environmental protection in that country.

tree.heading: Role of United States and multilateral assistance
tree.text: A statement of strategy for United States assistance for the next 5 years to address environmental problems in Poland and Hungary, including—

children.text: recommendations for appropriate levels and forms of bilateral financial and technical assistance;
recommendations concerning United States participation in cooperative multilateral undertakings;
an assessment of the feasibility of debt-for-nature swaps as a technique of environmental protection in each country; and
recommendations for minimizing further environmental damage to Krakow, and for the protection and restoration of historic sites in that city.
